title: Use Seedream 5.0 Pro to deconstruct a complex collage into separate elements…
content: Use Seedream 5.0 Pro to deconstruct a complex collage into separate elements while preserving proportions, textures, and visual style, then use Seedance 2.0 to recombine those elements into a stop-motion video.
